那男人的朋友也赶来了，夏晚安见对方多了一个人，怕韩知谨和宋有蔓吃亏，也急忙跑过去拉偏架，所谓的拉偏架，就是只拉对方的人，艾姜一向胆小，在旁边一会儿喊韩知谨，一会儿喊有蔓，一会儿喊晚安，最后拿着个酒瓶，哆哆嗦嗦的跑上来，毫无攻击力的说着让对方住手……半个小时后，派出所。夏晚安、韩知谨、宋有蔓、艾姜排排坐。一个穿着警服的人，一脸严肃的盯着他们四个录口供。“名字。”四个人一一回答：“夏晚安”、“韩知谨”、“宋有蔓”、“艾姜”。“年龄。”“23”，“23”，“23”，“23”。“去酒吧做什么？”夏晚安老实回答“玩”，韩知谨对着手机屏幕看着嘴角的淤青有点担忧的回“跟朋友玩啊”，宋有蔓像是听到了笑话一般回“这还需要问吗？”，艾姜怯弱的说“我们就是一起聚个会……”“看到这条标语了吗？认识字吗？给我读一遍。”四个人沉默。“读呀！”四个人异口同声的开了口：“莫打架，打架代价大，打赢坐牢，打输住院。”“为什么打架？”“……”“知不知道打架是不对的？”“……”警察一连问了好几个问题后，看向了艾姜。因为她自始至终都没动手，所以警察对她批评教育了一通后，让她签了字，走人了，至于剩下的夏晚安、韩知谨和宋有蔓三个人，则需要有人来保释。保释……夏晚安和宋有蔓同时为难而又求救的看向了韩知谨。要是她们给家长打电话，来保释她们，后果真的是不堪设想……接收到她们的目光，韩知谨咬了咬牙，掏出手机，给老宅去了个电话。接电话的是管家。“张妈，你来派出所接我，你偷偷的来，别被太奶奶和我妈知道了……不是只有我一个人，还有小婶婶和有蔓……”挂断电话后，三个人耐心的等。约莫二十分钟后，有警察推开他们在的房间，开口喊道：“韩知谨，夏晚安，宋有蔓，有人来接你们了，你们来这里签个字，就可以走了……”三个人按照警察的指示，规规矩矩的签了字，然后一前一后的走出了派出所的大厅。正好和他们打架的那两个人，也有人来接了，在门口碰了个正着。宋有蔓用口型无声的冲着那两个人骂，韩知谨冲着那两个人竖了个中指，然后在双方暗自较劲时，不远处有着一道男声响起：“夫人，知谨小少爷，宋小姐。”听到这声音，三个人齐刷刷的一愣，再也顾不上跟那两个人较劲了，立刻闻声望去。只见不远处的路边，韩经年的助理，站在一辆黑色的轿车前，笑眯眯的正看着三个人。～

Chapter 19 Win in jail and lose in hospital 1 (Page 1)
The man's friends also arrived. Xia Wan'an saw that there was an extra person in the other party. He was afraid that Han Zhijin and Song Youman would suffer, so he hurried over to try to pull the strings. The so-called pulling the strings meant that he only pulled the other person's side. Ai Jiang was always timid, calling Han Zhijin, Youman, and good night. Finally, holding a bottle, he ran up shivering and asked the other party to stop with a non-aggressive voice... Half an hour later, the police station arrived. Xia Wanwan, Han Zhijin, Song Youman, and Ai Jiang were sitting in a row. A man in a police uniform stared at the four of them with a serious face while recording their confessions. "Name." The four people answered one by one: "Good night Xia", "Han Zhijin", "Song Youman", and "Ai Jiang". "Age." "23", "23", "23", "23". "What are you going to the bar for?" Xia Wan'an answered honestly, "To play." Han Zhijin looked at the bruise on the corner of his mouth and looked at the mobile phone screen and replied with a little worry, "Playing with friends." Song Youman replied, as if he had heard a joke, "Do I still need to ask?", Ai Jiang said timidly, "We are just having a party together..." "Did you see this slogan? Do you know the words? Read it to me." The four of them were silent. "Read it!" The four people said in unison: "Don't fight. Fighting is expensive. If you win, you will go to jail, if you lose, you will be hospitalized." "Why fight?" "..." "Do you know that fighting is wrong?" "..." After the policeman asked several questions in a row, he looked at Ai Jiang. Because she didn't do anything from beginning to end, the police criticized her and asked her to sign and leave. As for the remaining three people, Xia Wan'an, Han Zhijin, and Song Youman, someone needed to bail them out. Bail... Xia Wan'an and Song Youman looked at Han Zhijin in embarrassment and begging for help. If they called their parents to bail them out, the consequences would be really disastrous... After receiving their looks, Han Zhijin gritted his teeth, took out his cell phone, and called his old house. The butler answered the phone. "Zhang Ma, you come to the police station to pick me up. You come here secretly. Don't let grandma and my mother know... I'm not the only one, there are also my aunt and Youman..." After hanging up the phone, the three of them waited patiently. About twenty minutes later, a policeman pushed open the room where they were and shouted: "Han Zhijin, good night Xia, Song Youman, someone is here to pick you up. You can come here and sign, and then you can leave..." The three people followed the police's instructions, signed in a decent manner, and then walked out of the lobby of the police station one after another. The two people who happened to be fighting with them were also picked up by someone, and they bumped into each other at the door. Song Youman silently cursed at the two people, and Han Zhijin raised his middle finger at the two people. Then while the two sides were secretly competing, a male voice not far away sounded: "Madam, young master Zhijin, Miss Song." Upon hearing this voice, the three of them were stunned. They no longer cared about competing with the two people, and immediately left after hearing the voice. I saw Han Jingnian's assistant standing in front of a black car on the roadside not far away, looking at the three people with a smile. ~
